body:
Rule (Fable2): file an Engram item BEFORE sending any message that cites its id, and never in the same parallel tool batch. Wait for the add result and copy the returned short_ref.

Repeat violation at 14:46Z on 2026-11-03: I sent Asistant #141 citing a guessed "w-74c8" in the same batch as the add, and the real ref was w-8c622b63fa50. I corrected it in the next message.
